_llm_instructions: Fill in the 'project_title' and 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' property of each field, based on the provided project context. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.

f01_Review_Purpose_and_Evaluation_Period.label: Review Purpose and Evaluation Period
f01_Review_Purpose_and_Evaluation_Period.guidance: The post-handover evaluation objectives and the operating timeframe assessed (typically 3 to 6 months post go-live).

f02_Lead_Evaluator_and_Date.label: Lead Evaluator and Date
f02_Lead_Evaluator_and_Date.guidance: The designated business assurance lead or PMO evaluator conducting the review and the completion date.

f03_Planned_vs_Realized_Benefits.label: Planned vs Realized Benefits
f03_Planned_vs_Realized_Benefits.guidance: Quantitative comparison of financial and operational benefits realized in steady-state operations versus business case projections.

f04_Operational_Adoption_Rate.label: Operational Adoption Rate
f04_Operational_Adoption_Rate.guidance: Metrics reflecting user adoption, system throughput, and behavioral integration into routine operations.

f05_Operational_Stability_and_Support.label: Operational Stability and Support
f05_Operational_Stability_and_Support.guidance: Assessment of post-transition SLA adherence, support ticket volume, and operational maintenance handover efficacy.

f06_Outstanding_Issues_and_Technical_Deb.label: Outstanding Issues and Technical Debt
f06_Outstanding_Issues_and_Technical_Deb.guidance: Inventory of lingering operational bugs, unresolved defects, or technical debt requiring long-term maintenance.

f07_Strategic_Lessons_Learned.label: Strategic Lessons Learned
f07_Strategic_Lessons_Learned.guidance: High-level strategic insights on solution viability, change management effectiveness, and business model impact.

f08_Ongoing_Optimization_Recommendations.label: Ongoing Optimization Recommendations
f08_Ongoing_Optimization_Recommendations.guidance: Prescriptive guidance for continuous optimization, future phase enhancements, and long-term capability extension.
